config.phase: development screen: prompt versus constrained decoding, no policy-effect scoring
config.input_changes: Reuse all 96 frozen v3 contexts. Relabel numeric home hours as time at home, remove lines starting - 판단 원칙:, append exact allowed zone anchor strings. Preserve contradictory source lifestyle text and flag it; no silent persona rewrite. Apply identical input changes to all candidates.
config.schema: Allowed field types, exact anchor enum, home/work/category consistency, no-workplace when none supplied, event count bounds. No spending values, policy-specific actions or expected treatment effects.
config.primary: First-response raw schedule contract >=95%, no request failures. Zero unsupported fiscal benefit screen flags. Unsupported-memory screen flags require source review; any confirmed fabricated memory prevents promotion.
config.selection: Do not select by propensity or spending effect. Among eligible candidates prefer source-grounded explanations, then lower token cost. Schema contribution is distinguished from prompt contribution. Confirm on new personas/seeds and controlled factual stress cases before integration.
config.stop_rule: Complete all 288 cells once; no hidden retries or overwrites. Failed screen leads to new versioned development trial, not ending the user-authorized optimization. Macro claims require separate spending validation.
config.prohibitions: P010 immutable; P015 not run; no empirical outcome numbers or policy-specific direction in universal instructions. Known cases remain development data.
